validity.recommendation: Investigate merging/relabeling against P1958 (Safaniyah-Juaymah Oil Pipeline) in GOIT; this gas row appears to be the same physical Safaniya->Juaymah trunk double-counted as a dry-gas line. If retained, reclassify (see classification concern) or delete.
validity.researcher_notes: RE-AUDIT of P1902 'Safianah/Safianayh-Ju'aymah gas pipeline' (gas tracker; Eastern Province, KSA; len=198 km, dia=40 in, status=operating, owner Saudi Aramco). The ONLY citations on the gem.wiki page are OPEC Annual Statistical Bulletin 2012 p.75 / ASB2013 p.79 (both now 402/403 dead, not independently re-verifiable). DUPLICATE FINDING: the live GOIT oil tracker contains P1958 'Safaniyah-Juaymah Oil Pipeline' (Saudi Arabia, Fuel=Oil, LengthKnown=198.0 km, Diameter=46,48 in, status=operating) -- IDENTICAL 198 km length and the same Safaniya->Juaymah endpoints, near-identical name. Independent sourcing confirms a real ~198 km Safaniya-field-to-Ju'aymah CRUDE system (twin 48-in submarine crude lines to the Ju'aymah crude terminal; Fluor Ju'aymah Oil Terminal & Pipelines project; Riviera/oedigital report Aramco's ongoing 48-in Safaniya offshore crude trunklines). There is NO independent evidence of a separate dedicated 198 km dry-gas transmission line from Safaniya to Ju'aymah. The single thin OPEC-list source for the gas row, the identical 198 km figure, and the existence of P1958 together indicate P1902 is the same physical pipe recorded a second time in the gas tracker (OPEC ASB pipeline lists mix oil and gas trunks). Diameter even differs (40 vs 46/48), consistent with sloppy list-derived entry rather than a distinct documented gas line.

validity.recommendation: If P1902 is not deleted as a duplicate of P1958, verify whether it is really a gas line at all; Safaniya field associated gas does NOT travel via a dedicated 198 km trunk to Ju'aymah -- it is gathered to Safaniya GOSP-1 / Tanajib and sent along the coast to Berri/Shedgum/Ju'aymah processing. Reclassify or correct endpoints/commodity.
validity.researcher_notes: CLASSIFICATION/EXISTENCE-AS-RECORDED doubt. The independent Fluor 'Aramco Offshore Gas Gathering Plant' description (primary EPC contractor) details the actual Safaniya/Marjan/Zuluf associated-gas routing: Safaniya GOSP-2/3/4 gas is compressed offshore and sent to Safaniya GOSP-1 ONSHORE 'for further handling', Marjan gas goes to Tanajib, Zuluf gas to Safaniya; recovered gas then travels 'along the coast to processing facilities at Berri, Shedgum and Ju'aymah' over 'more than 150 miles of various diameter pipelines, primarily offshore.' That is a gathering network feeding multiple plants -- NOT a single 198 km dry-gas transmission trunk from Safaniya to Ju'aymah. Ju'aymah's own gas role is an NGL fractionation plant fed by the NGL system from Shedgum/Uthmaniyah, not by a raw-gas line from Safaniya. So even if a Safaniya-related gas line exists, recording it as a 198 km / 40-in Safaniya->Ju'aymah dry-gas transmission pipeline misrepresents the documented system (it is either the crude trunk P1958, or part of the offshore gathering network, not a 198 km gas trunk). No independent source corroborates the 40-in diameter or the 198 km length for a GAS line.

fills.researcher_notes: Ownership of all Safaniya-field and Ju'aymah gas/oil infrastructure is Saudi Aramco (100%) -- this is robustly corroborated regardless of the duplicate/classification doubt, since both Fluor project records and all news coverage attribute the Safaniya->Ju'aymah systems to Saudi Aramco. Owner ref is safe to stage even though the row's existence-as-a-distinct-gas-line is in question. Did NOT fill Length/Diameter/Capacity refs: those values (198 km / 40 in / blank) cannot be independently corroborated for a GAS line and the row may be a duplicate of P1958 -- forcing refs onto disputed specs would be inappropriate.

summary: P1902 is almost certainly a duplicate/misclassification of GOIT's P1958 Safaniyah-Juaymah Oil Pipeline (identical 198 km, same endpoints); no independent evidence of a distinct 198 km/40-in dry-gas Safaniya->Ju'aymah trunk -- Safaniya associated gas actually gathers to GOSP-1/Tanajib then feeds Berri/Shedgum/Ju'aymah. Owner (Saudi Aramco) confirmed.
